title: Bind the retuned ordinary rate to the complete T74 layer
body:
PR3562's stronger ordinary rate cannot be substituted directly into PR3477's T74 proof: `tau=332353/332929` is below the complete T74 moment threshold, reversing the old summation inequality. This package closes that consumer step under the retained source/physical premises. It binds `Profile(1,577)` to an opt-in T74 factory and proves conditional layer time **O_q(V d^.998273)**, retaining the full child histogram, exponent-1000 stopping, root domain/reservations and storage/endpoint contracts. The layer saving improves from `.001695` to `.001727`; this is not a new multiplication exponent.

The complete moment at `sigma=.998271` passes two exact engines. Internal work uses the `tau<sigma` tree branch; stopped leaves cost exponent `.998272729`, leaving exact margin `271/10^9`. Both the direct ordinary-moment substitution and one extra rank-one child fail. A separate rational toy tree checks the reversed inequality, strict stop and leaf invoice.

The production constructor preserves the retained native construction AST except its profile. A private T74 binding alias avoids a real short-module-name collision with the native catalogue. The complete entry point has constructor-recording controls; all 35 files from PR3562's exact backend export are byte-identical in the authenticated T74 archive closure. PR3562's theorem/interface/manifest are retained without depending on its unmerged Git object at replay time.

Validation:

- Registered Python 3.12 checks with `-I -O -Werror -B`, including nine factory rejection controls and direct/fast reduced root returns.
- Normal/optimized exact rate checks and metadata/source pins. Publication `1630afea0fc1083717b5b2799b8de7a819a6ea02` passes committed-byte/source-history checks for 32 files. Both Git-free export commands reproduce identical receipts; all 33 regular export files (including manifest) remain unchanged after replay.
- Reduced root checks: four direct packets and one fast packet, five balanced recursive returns. Ordinary `run` counts are **[0,0]**; these verify object installation and root behavior, not the fitted ordinary branch or production GL64/T74 execution.

Remaining limits: ordinary/C0, native/common-label, hosting, height and physical refinement remain inherited conditional premises; the all-size PR3562 theorem is not independently reproved. This retains `d=floor(p^.997)` and does not import PR3493's smaller dimension plan or complete its analytic/error/packing invoice. No selected-frontier or shared-default changes.

Started from canonical main `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, priority revision 6, taking the [explicit PR3562 handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-19012323). The pre-submission refresh found a [concurrent actual-width/deeper-stop effort](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-19009513); this independent contribution retains the old root/stopping and does not duplicate that broader scope. Coordination and overlap: [canonical claim/result](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2612#discussioncomment-19012654). The `independent-moment` scope change is recorded in TASK.json; no new lowering search or supplier admission is claimed.

Credit: Jose Manuel/PR3562,3477,3385 and physical-backend lineage; Marius-Paul Dumitrean/PR2979 and Jeremy Kothe's predecessor work; Douglas Colkitt and Nick Petalas/PR3342 exact interval engines; David Arias, Adam Gall, Gareth Davidson and the retained ordinary/native/compiler/hosting notices. Hiroki KUMAZAKI (`kumagi`), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in proof, code, checks and prose. Apache-2.0.
